# team-gitops

Per-team ArgoCD instances for application delivery

```yaml
stack:
  teamGitops:
    enabled: true
```

## Settings

Under `stack.teamGitops.config`. Maps merge across layers; lists are replaced whole.

| Key | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `namespacePrefix` | Namespace prefix; each team gets &lt;prefix>-&lt;team> | `openshift-gitops` |
| `argoName` | Name of the ArgoCD resource inside each team namespace | `argocd-dev` |
| `teams` | Teams to create, keyed by name. Values override `defaults` below, e.g. `dev: {rbacPolicies: ["g, dev-leads, role:admin"]}` or `test: {ha: true, resources: {server: {limits: {cpu: "1"}}}}`. Which clusters get which teams is decided by where you set this in the cascade. | `{}` |
| `defaults` | Applied to every team unless the team overrides them |  |
| `defaults.rbacPolicies` | RBAC every team instance gets, before its own entries | `['g, system:cluster-admins, role:admin']` |
| `defaults.resources` | Requests and limits per ArgoCD component | 5 entries, below |

## Policies

`<cluster>` is the ManagedCluster name, or hubName on the hub. `global.remediationAction: inform` overrides every action below.

Standards: NIST SP 800-53. Controls: CM-2 Baseline Configuration. Categories: CM Configuration Management.

### Policy `teams`

`teams-team-gitops-<cluster>`: Per-team ArgoCD instances. Depends on `install-gitops-<cluster>`.

| Template | Action | Renders | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `teams-instances` | enforce | [team-argocd](converters/team-argocd.yaml) | Namespace and ArgoCD instance per team |
